01 [BIG SIGNAL]  Claude Sonnet 4.5 silently broke production structured outputs
     Agents & Tooling · San Francisco
     A team running a Claude-powered reporting pipeline discovered that upgrading to Sonnet 4.5 caused the model to fold JSON payload fields and start asking clarifying questions — behaviors that crashed downstream systems. Rolling back to…
     → Pin model versions in prod and run structured-output evals before every upgrade
     → Design pipelines to handle clarifying-question responses, not just structured JSON
     ↳ https://venturebeat.com/orchestration/when-claude-changed-everything-changed-managing-ai-blast-radius-in-production

02  OpenAI Lockdown Mode limits agent features to block prompt injection
     Evals & Quality · San Francisco
     OpenAI is rolling out Lockdown Mode to ChatGPT Business accounts, disabling live web browsing, image retrieval, deep research, and agent mode. The goal is to reduce data exfiltration risk from prompt injection — though OpenAI…
     → Evaluate Lockdown Mode for any ChatGPT Business deployment handling sensitive customer data
     → Treat prompt injection as a first-class threat in your agent security model, not an…
     ↳ https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/06/openai-unveils-lockdown-mode-to-protect-sensitive-data-from-prompt-injection-attacks/

03  OpenAI pivots ChatGPT toward agentic super app model
     Products & UX · San Francisco

     → Expect ChatGPT's UX surface to shift toward task delegation — audit your integration assumptions…
     → OpenAI's Codex push signals coding agents as the primary monetization wedge to watch
     ↳ https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/07/openai-is-still-working-on-that-super-app/
